Aberrancy.description: When taking DMG, if the attacker is affected by ailment or debuff, reduces DMG taken by the caster.

Aqua Vortex.description: Creates a vortex at a selected grid within 4 grids of the caster. The vortex deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids and pulls them to its center, with a 40% base chance to inflict Wet for 2 turns.

Auroradrasil Energy.description: Use it to break treasure seals in the Grand Treasure Hunt event. Any unused energy carries over to the next season.

Auroral Elemental Badge.description: Use 10 to get a capsule of your chosen element from the Aeonic Gacha.

Basic Treats.description: Feed it to Fantomons for 50 EXP.

Blade of Judgment.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, inflicts 1 stack of Mark on them. When Mark stacks to 10, deals Physical DMG once to the target.

Blade of Lament.description: Each time a Technique deals DMG to an enemy, triggers a Lifesteal effect, up to 50% of the caster's max HP.

Blade Siphon.description: Heals the caster once each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy.

Blade Tempest.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to trigger Sword Gale that deals additional Wind DMG once.

Blazing Fire Ring.description: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

Boiling Bloodlust.description: Increases the caster's Crit Rate and Crit DMG for 4 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Bond Trinket.description: Use it at Arborisfatum to summon Fantomons.

Cotton Sheep.description: Raise it in your Guild Sheepfold to produce wool used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Counter Blade.description: When damaged by an enemy's Technique within 2 grids of the caster, there is a 50% chance to counterattack, dealing Physical DMG once to the attacker.

Dark Bullet.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG once, with a 50% base chance to inflict Erosion.

Dawn Chicken.description: Raise it in your Guild Roost to produce eggs used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Dawnium.description: A currency for shop purchases, obtainable through exchanging Luminium at a 1:1 ratio.

Defensive Assault.description: Grants an ATK boost when the caster is shielded.

Desperate Protection.description: Grants a shield based on the caster's DEF to the ally with the lowest HP within 3 grids of the caster, lasting for 3 turns.

Desperate Valor.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

Destiny Fruit.description: Search the world map for mysterious rewards. Remember, uncollected destiny resources will disappear after a while.

Divine Wrath.description: Selects a target within 4 grids of the caster. Randomly deals Light DMG 16 times within 3 grids of the target, hitting at least 3 times. DMG decreases by 40% for each subsequent hit on the same target. (Prioritizes the skill range that contains large targets.)

Elemental Harmony.description: For each element among equipped Techniques that deal DMG, increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Stacks up to 4 times.

Energy Burst.description: Your next damaging Technique gains increased Accuracy and deals 50% more DMG.

Epic Auroral Badge.description: Use 10 to get a capsule from the Epic Aeonic Gacha.

Explosive Spirit.description: For every Fire Technique cast, increases the caster's Crit Rate for 2 turns. Stacks up to 8 times.

Falling Dark Star.description: At the start of the caster's turn, the caster gains 1 random buff that lasts until the start of the caster's next turn.

Fiery Burst.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Fire Crit DMG to an enemy, deals additional Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target.

Fire Blast.description: Deals Fire DMG once to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster.

Fireball.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid.

Flame Aura.description: Grants Flame to the caster and 3 random allies within 3 grids of the caster for 2 turns. This effect cannot be dispelled.

Flame Jet.description: Deals Fire DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 1×3 grid area in front of the caster.

Flame Wolf Summon.description: Summons 2 Flame Wolves in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, starts in Stealth, and remains for up to 2 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Flaming Path.description: When the caster starts to move in their turn, there is a 30% chance to inflict Burn to grids within 1 grid of the caster.

Flash Dash.description: Dashes 5 grids in a straight line, dealing Physical Doom DMG once to all enemies in a 1×4 grid area along the path. (Cannot penetrate enemies larger than 4 grids)

Flowing Doom.description: Deals Water DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 3×5 grid area in front of the caster, with a 50% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

Formation Breaker.description: Increases ATK for all allied characters within 3 grids of the caster by a percentage of the caster's ATK for 2 turns. This effect is unique. Also there's a 50% chance to advance the action bar of allied characters by 20%. (Zero Initial CD)

Frame of Battles.description: Reduces the caster's DMG taken for every 15% HP lost. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

Frenzy Totem.description: Summons 1 Totem in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, starts in Stealth, and remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Frost Guard.description: At the end of the caster's turn, if no Technique was cast this turn, the caster enters the Icebound status, which reduces DMG taken and lasts until the start of the caster's next turn. This status heals the caster once before it expires.

Gale Shield.description: Grants a shield based on the caster's max HP before battle starts. When the shield disappears, deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the caster, with a 100% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

Gateway Key.description: Use it to unlock a sealed pillar on the world map.

Gold Pickaxe.description: Use it to mine gold ore in the Realm: Gilded Depths.

Gravity Pull.description: Selects a grid within 7 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid and pulls them to the caster's location.

Guardian Ring.description: Grants a shield based on DEF to the caster for 2 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Healing Touch.description: Heals 1 ally within 5 grids of the caster once and dispels 1 random ailment or debuff from them.

Heart of Challenge.description: Deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster, with an 85% chance to inflict Taunt for 1 turn. Has a 100% chance to inflict Taunt non-character units. (Casts once before battle starts.)

Heavy Impact.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG once and knocking them airborne (Prioritizes large targets)

Hopeful Bud.description: Plant it in your Guild Garden to produce oil used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Howling Hurricane.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 5 times to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, knocking them airborne.

Hunter's Judgment.description: Selects a grid within 4 grids of the caster. Pulls all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid to the grid in front of the caster, then deals Physical DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 3×3 grid area in front of the caster and knocks them airborne.

Ice Spike.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 1×5 grid area in front of the caster, with a 40% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

Indomitable Will.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, survives with 1 HP, enters the Indomitable status for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled), and heals the caster once.

Insight.description: Increases the caster's Effect Hit Rate.

Iron Fortress.description: Before battle starts, increases the DEF of all allied characters within a 3-grid square area of the caster by a percentage of the caster's own DEF. This effect is unique and cannot be dispelled.

Iron Hammer.description: Use it to mine iron ore in the Realm: Ironvein Pit.

Iron Thorn.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Immobilize for 1 turn.

Legendary Auroral Badge.description: Use 10 to get a capsule from the Legendary Aeonic Gacha.

Light of Dawn.description: Deals Light Doom DMG twice to all enemies in a 1×8 grid area in front of the caster.

Lightning Chain.description: Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster. The effect then chains to 1 random enemy within 4 grids of the target, up to 8 times. Each enemy can only be hit once by the chain effect.

Lightning Mystery.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 30% chance to trigger Thunder Strike that deals additional Light DMG once.

Linked Misfortune.description: Each time the caster inflicts Erosion on an enemy, there's a 60% chance to inflict Erosion again.

Lucky Ticket.description: Use it to spin the Wheel of Destiny for rewards.

Luminium.description: Use them to exchange for Dawnium or buy items.

Lunar Chicken.description: Raise it in your Guild Roost to produce eggs used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Lunar Heart.description: Plant it in your Guild Garden to produce oil used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Lunar Sheep.description: Raise it in your Guild Sheepfold to produce wool used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Lunarwater Threads.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 5 grids of the caster, with a 50% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold for 2 turns and pulls them to the caster's location.

Mantra of Blessings.description: At the start of the caster's turn, grants Blessing to the allied character with the highest ATK, increasing their DMG. This effect lasts until the start of the caster's next turn and cannot be dispelled.

Meteoric Flames.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, with a 60% chance to inflict Burn on grids within range. (Prioritizes large targets)

Mountain Collapse.description: Deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, knocking them airborne, with a 60% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

Mythic Auroral Badge.description: Use 10 to get a capsule from the Mythic Aeonic Gacha.

Overhealing.description: Has a 30% chance to additionally heal all allies within 1 grid of the target each time the caster heals allies with a Technique.

Overload Protection.description: Within a single turn, each time the caster loses over 15% of max HP, grants the caster a shield based on their max HP for 2 turns.

Piercing Assault.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, the caster ignores a portion of the target's DEF. The DEF ignorance increases by 10% for each buff the caster has, stacking up to 3 times.

Radiant Restoration.description: Heals all allies within 4 grids of the caster once.

Radiant Sear.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Light DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

Raging Wildfire.description: Has a 20% chance to inflict Burn to grids within range when casting a Fire Technique.

Rapid Cast.description: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Before battle starts, reduces the CD of all Techniques by 1 turn. (Techniques already off cooldown are not affected.)

Rebound.description: Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF.

Repelling Wind.description: Has a 75% chance to trigger Repelling Wind when an enemy actively enters within 2 grids of the caster, dealing Wind DMG once, with a 100% base chance to knock them back 2 grids. (Triggers again if they approach repeatedly)

Resilient Sprout.description: Plant it in your Guild Garden to produce oil used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Resurrection.description: When an allied adventurer dies, immediately revives and heals them once, granting Revitalization for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This Charm can only trigger once per battle. Before battle starts, if multiple allied adventurers are dead, reviving the one with the highest Power first.

Rolla.description: Use them for gear enhance, ascension, and buying items from the shop.

Sand Shovel.description: Use it to mine sand in the Realm: Dustfall Dune.

Shadow Erosion.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy, there is a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.

Shadow Impact.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of that target grid. If the enemy target carries Erosion, triggers Erosion effect twice immediately.

Shadow of Termination.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster. If the target carries Erosion, triggers all Erosion stacks immediately. (Prioritizes large targets)

Shadow Vengeance.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters Shadow Form, lasting until the end of the caster's turn (up to 4 global turns). The effect cannot be dispelled. In this form, the caster is immune to all DMG, can't be healed, won't be the primary target of attacks, deals increased DMG, and reduces Technique CD by 2 turns. (The caster dies immediately if failing to win when Shadow Form ends, ignoring any effects that would preserve HP.)

Shattering Ice.description: When a target frozen by the caster removes the Frozen state, additionally deals Water DMG once.

Skill Shard Voucher.description: Exchange it for skill shards at the Goddess Statue.

Soul Breaker.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost of the target. Stacks up to 5 times.

Soul Impact.description: When the caster's summon dies or expires, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of it.

Soul Pact Resonance.description: Grants an ATK boost when the caster has a summon on the battlefield.

Soul Splash.description: The caster's Single-Hit Techniques deal more DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Fire True DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target, equal to 60% of overkill DMG.

Soulfire Protection.description: Before battle starts, consumes 50% of the caster's current HP to grant the caster a DMG Reduction effect. This effect cannot be dispelled.

Stamina.description: Required for gathering on Blessed Lands and fighting monsters on the world map. Recovers 5 Stamina per hour, up to 300.

Star Shattering Slash.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)

Starlight Burst.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

Steely Chicken.description: Raise it in your Guild Roost to produce eggs used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Stellatie.description: Use it for Goddess Prayer to gain skills.

Stone Sheep.description: Raise it in your Guild Sheepfold to produce wool used to activate Fantomon Aptitudes.

Summon Crystal.description: Exchange them for items at the Arborisfatum's Summon Shop!

Sunset Sword.description: Deals Physical DMG 5 times to all enemies in a 3×2 grid area in front of the caster.

T10 Amber.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your HP and Healing Boost.

T10 Amethyst.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your SPD and Crit Rate.

T10 Beryl.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your HP.

T10 Citrine.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your SPD.

T10 Moonstone.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your DEF and DMG RES.

T10 Obsidian.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your ATK and DMG Boost.

T10 Ruby.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your ATK.

T10 Sapphire.description: Inlay gear with it to amplify your DEF.

Tactical Adaptation.description: When there are 3 or fewer enemies within 2 grids, increases the caster's DMG dealt. When there are more than 3 enemies within 2 grids, reduces the caster's DMG taken.

Tempest Sphere.description: Deals Wind DMG 5 times to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.

Thunder of Judgment.description: Deals Light DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)

Unstable Aura.description: When the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 25% chance to trigger Aura, dealing additional Wind DMG once, with a 60% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

Valor Surge.description: Grants a DMG Boost to all allied characters within 5 grids of the caster for 2 turns and dispels 1 random status ailment or debuff. (Casts once before battle starts.)

Void Bubble.description: When the caster's HP drops below 50% for the first time in a battle, grants a shield to the caster based on max HP for 2 turns and Dodge for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).

Water Assault.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 3×4 grid area in front of the caster. DMG decreases by 25% for each subsequent hit on the same target. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

Water Shot.description: Deals Water DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

Water to Ice.description: When the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to trigger Condensation, dealing additional Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

Waterling Summon.description: Summons 1 Waterling behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, starts in Stealth, and remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Weakening Hex.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.

Whirlwind Slash.description: Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the caster.

Wind's Shadow.description: Has a 30% chance to deal additional Wind DMG once and a 50% base chance to delay the target's action by 20% after dealing Wind DMG 3 times to an enemy with Techniques.

Worn Knuckles.description: Use them to fight monsters in the Realm: Dread Hollow.
